title: Cardinal Onaiyekan Speaking For Catholics, Rooting For Peter Obi, Says Tinubu's Aide, Daniel Bwala
desc: Daniel Bwala, the Special Adviser to President Bola Tinubu on Policy Communication, has accused the Archbishop Emeritus of the Catholic Archdiocese of Abuja, Cardinal John Onaiyekan of engaging in partisan politics. He alleged that the Catholic cleric was speaking for institutions sympathetic to the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) presidential candidate, Peter Obi, rather than representing the broader Christian community.
